translation:
Fall 2026 Graduate Thesis Defense Public Presentations – Attendance Procedures for Master's/Doctoral Seminar (석박사세미나) Students

This notice explains how students enrolled in the Master's/Doctoral Seminar in Fall 2026 may attend public thesis defense presentations.

Please check the date, time and venue of the defense you will attend, and the online participation link, in the attachment to the master's and doctoral thesis defense public presentation schedule (석사·박사 논문심사 공개발표 일정). The schedule may change at any time, so please also check the latest attachment on the day you attend.

1. In-person attendance

Attend at the venue without applying separately to the department office.

Complete the attached attendance confirmation form, have it signed on site by the supervisor of the student whose thesis is being examined, and submit it to the teaching assistant in charge of the seminar.

2. Online attendance

After confirming which public defenses allow online participation, apply to attend by emailing the department office (email address in the original notice) no later than one week before the defense date.

In your application email, state your name and student ID number, and the name of the student being examined, their program (master's or doctoral) and the date and time of the defense. If you cannot attend after applying, please notify the office by email by the day before the defense.

Please join using the participation link shown in the published schedule attachment. If the link is shown as still being confirmed, please check the latest schedule.

Set your online meeting display name to your student ID number and name, and turn on your camera so that your attendance can be confirmed.

3. Submission of the attendance confirmation form for online attendance

After attending the defense, complete the attached attendance confirmation form and submit it to the department office (Building 301, Room 319).

The department office will confirm attendance by comparing the form with the attendee list submitted by the defense committee.

Attachment: Seminar Attendance Confirmation Form, 1 copy.

Inquiries: Department office, School of Electrical and Information Engineering (전기·정보공학부). Contact details are in the original notice.
